prompt: Create a Python 3.12 invoicing application. An invoice belongs to a customer and contains multiple invoice lines. Each line references a product and quantity. The invoice total must be calculated from its lines.

intentions.text: I can create a new invoice for a customer with multiple line items.
intentions.requires: a customer name, a list of products (with name and price), and quantities for each product
intentions.observable: a new invoice is created and stored, with the total calculated from the line items

intentions.text: I can view the details of an existing invoice, including the customer name and all line items.
intentions.observable: the invoice details are displayed, including customer name and each product with quantity and price

intentions.text: I can add a product to an invoice line with a specified quantity.
intentions.requires: an invoice identifier, a product name, and a quantity
intentions.observable: the invoice line is updated with the new product and quantity, and the total is recalculated

intentions.text: I can remove a product line from an invoice.
intentions.requires: an invoice identifier and a product line identifier or index
intentions.observable: the specified line is removed, and the invoice total is recalculated

intentions.text: I can calculate the total amount of an invoice from its line items.
intentions.requires: a list of invoice lines (each with product price and quantity)
intentions.observable: the total amount is computed and returned as a number

intentions.text: I can list all invoices with their customer names and totals.
intentions.observable: a list of invoices is displayed, showing customer name and total amount
